# Line Content Template (Skill Asset)

```markdown
# <Line Name>

## Quick Intro
<2 to 4 short sentences.>

## Story Time
<A short story-style section that explains the background of this line.>

<What problem did the city have before this line?>

<Why did people want to build it?>

<What was exciting or important about the construction or opening?>

<Why does this line still matter today?>

## Time Story
- <Year>: <What happened>
- <Year>: <What happened>
- <Year>: <What happened>

<Short paragraph about why this line matters.>

## Route Snapshot
- Start area: <...>
- End area: <...>
- Route role: <...>
- Transfer value: <...>

## Important Stations for Kids
### 1) <Station Name>
<Child-friendly explanation>

### 2) <Station Name>
<Child-friendly explanation>

### 3) <Station Name>
<Child-friendly explanation>

## Fun Facts
- <Verified fact 1>
- <Verified fact 2>
- <Verified fact 3>

## Word Helper
- <Term>: <Simple explanation>
- <Term>: <Simple explanation>
- <Term>: <Simple explanation>

## Memory Check
1. <Question 1>
2. <Question 2>
3. <Question 3>

## Sources
- <Source name>: <URL>
- <Source name>: <URL>
- <Source name>: <URL>
```
